title: 연락처 주고받기: 번호 좀 알려 주세요
objective: You can ask for a phone number with -(아/어) 주세요, read it aloud, and ask someone to repeat it.
summary: Learn how to ask for, give, and save a phone number or KakaoTalk contact.
setting: After a language exchange meetup at a café, Minsu and Maria exchange phone numbers and KakaoTalk contacts.

task.title: Ask for and share numbers
task.line: Use the dialogue and word list to make, read, and order the Korean sentences.

words.meaning: to tell someone (a piece of information)
words.exampleMeaning: The teacher gave me the number.
I looked at the number one more time.

words.meaning: to save (a contact in your phone)
words.exampleMeaning: Save the name with it, too.

words.meaning: a call or message (getting in touch)

dialogue.meaning: Same here. Let's meet again next time.
Sure. Could you give me your phone number?
Sorry. Please say it one more time.
I just called you. This is my number.
OK, I saved it. Do you use KakaoTalk too?

exercises: Make a polite request with 주세요: ① 이메일 주소를 쓰다 ② 내일 전화하다 ③ 이름을 읽다
Read this phone number aloud and write it in Korean: 010-9876-5432
Your new friend says the number too fast. Ask them to speak slowly in Korean (천천히 = slowly).
Put the lines in order: (가) 공일공, 사오육칠, 팔구공일이에요. (나) 수진 씨 전화번호가 뭐예요? (다) 고마워요. 바로 저장했어요.
answers: ① 이메일 주소를 써 주세요. ② 내일 전화해 주세요. ③ 이름을 읽어 주세요.
천천히 말해 주세요. (천천히 다시 한번 말해 주세요.)
